description.text:
The set of the villains of the games and the anime, released on 24 April 2000 with 83 cards and two theme decks, Devastation and Trouble; its symbol is the team's R. It brought in Dark Pokémon, evolved Pokémon twisted by Team Rocket, which a deck can play beside the ordinary Pokémon of the same name: four Arbok and four Dark Arbok. Like Jungle and Fossil, it printed almost all of its rares both holo and non-holo.

Dark Raichu, numbered 83/82 beyond the set's count, was the first secret rare in English or Japanese. It was an English exclusive until Japan printed it as a secret rare in Crossing the Ruins, its version of Neo Discovery. Dark Pokémon did not return in strength until EX Team Rocket Returns, four years later.
